titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Health and everyday symptoms: Essential vocabulary

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Health and everyday symptoms. Focus: Vocabulary.

texto: Essential vocabulary for health and physical symptoms: «ปวดหัว» (bpùat-hǔa, headache), «ไข้» (khâi, fever / high temperature), «ยา» (yaa, medicine / medication) and «พักผ่อน» (phák-phɔ̀ɔn, to rest / to relax). To describe bodily discomfort, «ปวด» (dull / deep ache) or «เจ็บ» (sharp pain / injury) is used + the body part: «ปวดท้อง» (stomach ache), «เจ็บคอ» (sore throat). To give or receive medical advice: «ถ้า...ควร...» (if..., you should...): «ถ้าไม่สบาย ควรพักผ่อน» (If you're unwell, you should rest). Dosage: «กินยาหลังอาหาร» (Take the medicine after eating).
